questions.stem: May I bring a friend to the party?
questions.explain:
by all means: 當然可以、務必
by any means: 無論如何、不擇手段
by chance: 偶然、碰巧
解析：題目問「我可以帶朋友去派對嗎？」，為請求許可的問句。by all means 表示「當然可以」，用於禮貌且熱情地答應請求，故答案選A。其他選項皆為介系詞 by 的片語陷阱：B是不擇手段、C是碰巧、D是出於自願，語意均不符合回答許可的情境。

questions.stem: Who are your target readers?
questions.explain:
target: 目標
reader: 讀者
teenager: 青少年
解析：題目詢問「誰是你的目標讀者？」疑問詞Who問的是人，四個選項中只有A選項Teenagers（青少年）是指特定人群，故答案選A。其他選項Newspapers（報紙）、Local markets（當地市場）與Smartphones（智慧型手機）皆為物品或地點，無法用來回答Who，屬於名詞對象混淆的干擾選項。

questions.stem: What's wrong with your pen?
questions.explain:
What's wrong with: ...怎麼了、出了什麼問題
out of ink: 沒墨水
battery is dead: 電池沒電
解析：題目詢問「你的筆怎麼了？」，意在詢問故障原因。A表示「沒墨水了」，完全符合語境，故答案選A。干擾選項B的電池沒電是用於電子產品；C回答位置在抽屜、D回答顏色是藍色，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: How did you know I was lying?

options.A: Your boss is an honest man.
options.C: Your dog was lying there, too.

questions.explain:
body language: 肢體語言
lie: 說謊；躺臥
convincing: 令人信服的
解析：題意為「你怎麼知道我在說謊？」，回答如何識破謊言最為合理，故答案選B。選項C利用lie的另一種意思「躺臥」設計字面陷阱；選項D說藉口很有說服力，邏輯矛盾；選項A扯到老闆與題目無關，皆不可選。

questions.stem: Are you nervous about going skydiving?

options.A: Yes, I enjoy flying a kite.
options.B: No, I can't wait to go.

questions.explain:
nervous: 緊張的
skydiving: 跳傘
can't wait to: 迫不及待
解析：題目詢問去跳傘是否會緊張。選項B回答不會且迫不及待想去，語意最合理，故答案選B。選項A放風箏與選項C去海外皆答非所問；選項D回答哪裡都不去則與即將跳傘的情境矛盾。

questions.stem: Why have you become a vet?

options.D: I love all kinds of meat.

questions.explain:
vet: 獸醫
become: 成為
vegetable: 蔬菜
解析：題意問「你為什麼成為獸醫？」。獸醫負責醫治動物，因此回答喜愛動物最合邏輯，答案選A。選項B利用字首發音與vet相近的vegetables（蔬菜）設下聽力陷阱；選項C戶外活動與選項D肉類則與提問完全無關。

questions.stem: Excuse me. Is this seat taken?
questions.explain:
Excuse me: 不好意思、請問
taken: 有人坐的、被佔用的
I'm afraid so: 恐怕是如此
解析：題目問「請問這座位有人坐嗎？」A選項委婉回答「恐怕有人坐了」，故答案選A。干擾項B是「我很害怕」，混淆afraid詞義；C利用excuse設「藉口」的字面陷阱；D意為「我完全同意」，皆與語境不合。

questions.stem: Do you have change for a hundred?

options.A: No, I won't change seats with you.
options.D: Let's eat something else for a change.

questions.explain:
change: 零錢
change seats: 換座位
change one's mind: 改變心意
for a change: 換換花樣
解析：題目問「你能把一百元鈔票換成零錢嗎？」，因此回答「讓我找找看」最合理，答案選B。選項A的換位子、C的改變心意及D的換口味，都是利用「改變、更換」的一字多義作為字面陷阱，與兌換零錢無關。

questions.stem: Let's go fishing, shall we?

options.A: But I already have a fish bowl.
options.B: But I hate to eat fish.

questions.explain:
go fishing: 去釣魚
be into: 對...感興趣
fish bowl: 金魚缸
解析：題目提議「我們去釣魚好嗎？」，選項C以「但我沒興趣」委婉拒絕，語意最自然合理，故答案選C。選項A、B、D皆為關鍵字干擾的字面陷阱，過度聯想至金魚缸、吃魚與肚子餓，均不符合拒絕活動提議的邏輯。

questions.stem: What brings you here?

options.B: I just arrived ten minutes ago.

questions.explain:
What brings you here?: 你怎麼會來這裡
invite: 邀請
解析：題意為「你怎麼會來？」，用以詢問對方的來意或原因，故答案選D，回答自己受邀而來最合適。選項A落入bring（帶來）的字面陷阱；選項B回答抵達時間；選項C回答交通方式，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: It's getting late. Could you see me home?

options.A: Sure, my home is large enough.
options.B: Sure, I can see you through.
options.C: Sure, my home is not far from here.
options.D: Sure, I'll be your escort tonight.

questions.explain:
see someone home: 護送某人回家
escort: 護送、護衛
see through: 看穿、陪伴度過難關
解析：題意為「天色晚了，你能送我回家嗎？」see someone home 是護送某人回家。答案選D，escort 是護送之意，符合語境。干擾選項 A 與 C 誤把 home 當成回答者自己的家，B 的 see through 則是看穿或陪伴度過難關，皆為混淆選項。

questions.stem: Where can I get some aspirin?
questions.explain:
aspirin: 阿斯匹靈（止痛藥）
drugstore: 藥局
orchard: 果園
解析：題目問「哪裡可以買到阿斯匹靈？」aspirin 屬常見成藥，應在藥局購買，故答案選A。選項 orchard（果園）、bookstore（書店）與 art museum（美術館）皆非販售藥品的場所，屬於生活場所單字的詞彙干擾。

questions.stem: Who's your commanding officer?
questions.explain:
commanding officer: 指揮官
colonel: 上校
private: 二等兵
解析：題意詢問誰是你的指揮官。答案選 C，因為 Colonel（上校）為軍官階級，符合指揮官身分。選項 A 與 B 拿警察及海關人員製造 officer 的字面陷阱；D 的 Private（二等兵）是士兵階級，並非軍官。

questions.stem: Which should you use to dig a trench?
questions.explain:
dig a trench: 挖戰壕
shovel: 圓鍬、鏟子
saw: 鋸子
解析：題目詢問挖掘戰壕該使用何種工具。挖土需使用圓鍬或鏟子，故答案選D。干擾選項A螺絲起子、B鋸子與C鞋拔皆非挖掘工具，為常見工具字彙陷阱。

questions.stem: What are you going to call your new baby?

options.A: I think I'll use my cell phone.
options.B: I think I'll give her a bath later.
options.C: I think I'll name her after my mother.
options.D: I think I'll throw a party.

questions.explain:
call: 取名、稱呼
name after: 以...命名
解析：題目問「你打算給新生寶寶取什麼名字？」call 在此指「命名」，因此答案選C（以母親的名字來為她命名）。選項A提到手機，是利用 call 也有「打電話」之意的字面陷阱；B（洗澡）與D（辦派對）均與題意無關。

questions.stem: How would you like your coffee?
questions.explain:
How would you like...: 你想要...如何調配/處理
black coffee: 黑咖啡（不加糖奶）
rare: （牛排）三分熟
解析：題目詢問咖啡想要怎麼喝。回答black表示要喝不加糖與奶精的黑咖啡，答案選B。干擾選項A的rare是用於牛排熟度；選項C與D則是詢問付款方式時的回答，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Do you have a light?
questions.explain:
light: 打火機；點火
quit smoking: 戒菸
解析：Do you have a light? 是借火點菸的常見口語。答案選D，回答因戒菸了所以沒帶火。選項A、B、C皆為字面多義陷阱，分別將 light 誤解為光線、清淡飲食及重量輕（對應 heavy），故皆不選。

questions.stem: Can't you stay a little longer?

options.A: I can say nothing more, really.

questions.explain:
stay a little longer: 再多留一會兒
I wish I could: 但願我可以（委婉拒絕）
解析：題目詢問「你不能再多留一會兒嗎？」，答案選D，意思是「真希望我可以（但我沒辦法）」，為社交上婉拒挽留的客氣回答。選項A為發音陷阱，將 stay 聽成 say；選項B「我希望如此」語意不合對話邏輯。

questions.stem: Why did you form a carpool?

options.A: We want to take public transportation.
options.D: We want to try on new uniforms.

questions.explain:
form a carpool: 組成共乘、拼車
conserve energy: 節省能源
play pool: 打撞球
解析：題目問「你們為什麼要組成共乘？」共乘的目的在於節省油錢與能源，因此答案選B。選項C利用 carpool 裡的 pool（撞球）設計字面音義陷阱；選項A搭大眾運輸則與自行開車共乘的情境不符。

questions.stem: Hold the elevator, will you?

options.C: Ok, I'll put you through immediately.

questions.explain:
hold the elevator: 按住電梯
you'd better: 你最好
put through: 轉接電話
解析：題意為「請按住電梯等我一下好嗎？」，A回覆「好，但你最好快點」符合情境，故答案選A。干擾項B的alligators（鱷魚）是發音相近的陷阱；C選項用於電話轉接，情境不符。

questions.stem: Why are you so jealous of your younger sister?

options.B: Everyone says she's more beautiful than I am.
options.C: I'm only a few minutes older than her.

questions.explain:
jealous of: 嫉妒
twin sisters: 雙胞胎姊妹
get along: 相處融洽
解析：題目問「你為什麼這麼嫉妒妹妹？」，詢問嫉妒的原因。B說明大家都說妹妹比自己漂亮，合理解釋了嫉妒的理由，故答案選B。干擾選項A與C僅提及兩人是雙胞胎與年齡差距，答非所問；D說相處很好，則與題目提及的嫉妒心態相互矛盾。

questions.stem: What's the matter with you?
questions.explain:
What's the matter: 你怎麼了、哪裡不舒服
dizzy: 頭暈的
It doesn't matter: 沒關係、不重要
解析：題意為關心詢問「你怎麼了？」，回答自己身體不適「我覺得頭暈」，語意最相符，答案選C。選項A與B是利用matter的名詞（事情）及動詞（要緊）設計字面陷阱；選項D表示自己是所有者，與問句完全無關。

questions.stem: How long has it been since you had your hair cut?

options.A: I've made an appointment with the dentist.
options.C: I've been waiting for you since morning.

questions.explain:
How long: 多久
have one's hair cut: 剪頭髮
解析：題意為「你距離上次剪頭髮有多久了？」，問的是一段時間長度，故答案選D（我想大概兩個月）。選項B是回答頻率（How often）；C是用題目出現的since做字面陷阱；A提到牙醫預約則是答非所問。

questions.stem: Do you know who's coming to dinner tonight?
questions.explain:
give someone a hint: 給某人提示
give someone a ride: 順路載某人一程
give someone a break: 饒了我吧、放過我吧
解析：題意為「你知道今晚誰要來吃晚餐嗎？」。回答「給我點提示」最符合猜測人選的對話情境，故答案選C。干擾項A是要求搭便車，B是表達不耐煩或求饒，D則是要求理由，語意皆與詢問名單無關。

questions.stem: Does Mary wear glasses at work?

options.A: Yes, she wears makeup at work.

questions.explain:
wear glasses: 戴眼鏡
nearsighted: 近視的
jewelry: 珠寶首飾
解析：題意為「瑪麗上班戴眼鏡嗎？」答案選C。nearsighted是近視，因近視而戴眼鏡合乎邏輯。選項A的化妝（makeup）、B的首飾（jewelry）及D的訂婚（engaged），皆是利用與wear搭配的外表裝飾詞彙設下語意陷阱，答非所問。

questions.stem: To tell you the truth, I'm burnt out.
questions.explain:
To tell you the truth: 說實話
burnt out: 精疲力竭、累壞了
broke: 身無分文的
解析：題意為「說實話，我累壞了」。「burnt out」指因工作或壓力導致精力耗盡，等同 extremely tired，故答案選A。選項B的 broke（沒錢）、C的 injured（受傷）及D的 unemployed（失業）皆非該片語之意，為混淆字義的干擾。

questions.stem: I'll have a day off tomorrow.

options.A: I don't have to go to work tomorrow.
options.B: The date will be delayed until tomorrow.
options.C: I'll go to work as usual tomorrow.
options.D: The deadline is only a day away.

questions.explain:
have a day off: 放假、休假
as usual: 照常、如同往常
deadline: 截止期限
解析：題目表示「我明天休假」。have a day off 即休假不用上班，故答案選A。選項C意思完全相反；選項B與D則是利用 date、delayed 與 deadline 等字形發音相近的詞彙所設下的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: We should size up the situation first.

options.A: We should emphasize the situation first.
options.B: We should ignore the situation first.
options.C: We should evaluate the situation first.
options.D: We should deal with the situation first.

questions.explain:
size up: 評估、打量
situation: 情況、局勢
evaluate: 評估、評價
解析：題意為我們應該先評估局勢。片語 size up 意指評估、審度，與 evaluate 意思相同，故答案選C。干擾項 A 的 emphasize（強調）與 B 的 ignore（忽略）語意不合；D 的 deal with 為處理應對，是評估之後才進行的動作，非字面原意。

questions.stem: The scandal hit the headlines.

options.A: The scandal was not revealed to the public.
options.B: The scandal was reported in many newspapers.

questions.explain:
scandal: 醜聞
hit the headlines: 登上頭條新聞
reveal: 揭露、公開
解析：題幹 hit the headlines 指登上新聞頭條，表示被各大報紙廣泛報導，故答案選B。選項A說未公開與題意相反；選項C調查中並非題意；選項D則是利用 headline 與 headache 音形相近的特點設計的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: The concert was a total disaster.

options.D: The concert was held as scheduled.

questions.explain:
total disaster: 徹底的災難、大失敗
failure: 失敗
as scheduled: 按照原定計畫
解析：題幹說音樂會是場大災難，引申為徹底失敗，與 failure 同義，故答案選A。干擾項B意思完全相反；C是過度推論的陷阱，辦得很糟不代表演出被取消；D僅表示如期舉行，並未說明結果好壞。

questions.stem: Vicky dumped her boyfriend yesterday.

options.B: She lied to her boyfriend yesterday.
options.C: She got rid of her boyfriend yesterday.
options.D: She made up with her boyfriend yesterday.

questions.explain:
dump: 甩掉、拋棄
get rid of: 擺脫、去除
make up with: 與...和好
解析：題意為 Vicky 昨天甩了她的男朋友。動詞 dump 在男女關係中指拋棄、甩掉對方，與 get rid of 語意最相近，故答案選C。選項 A（傷害）與 B（說謊）並非分手的核心意思；選項 D 的 make up with 為和好，意思完全相反，為常見的反義干擾。

questions.stem: You look like a million bucks!

options.C: You look like a movie star.

questions.explain:
look like a million bucks: 看起來光采奪目、非常迷人
attractive: 迷人的、有吸引力的
解析：片語 look like a million bucks 是讚美對方「氣色極佳、很有吸引力」，故答案選B。選項A取 bucks（美元）字面意思直譯為百萬富翁，是常見的字面陷阱；選項C與D則偏離原意。

questions.stem: In the last decade, this city has changed a lot.

options.A: This city has changed a lot in the last 10 years.
options.B: This city will change a lot in the future.
options.C: The city is still the same as it was.
options.D: This city used to be a fishing village.

questions.explain:
decade: 十年
change a lot: 改變很多
解析：題意為這座城市在過去十年改變很多。decade 等於 10 years，故答案選A。選項B錯在誤用未來式；選項C意思為沒有改變，與原意相反；選項D提到漁村純屬未提及的無關推論。

questions.stem: They are in the red right now.

options.C: They are running a red light.

questions.explain:
in the red: 虧損、負債
in the black: 獲利、有盈餘
解析：題幹片語 in the red 源自財務赤字概念，表示賠錢或負債，故答案選A。選項B、C、D皆為 red 的字面陷阱，分別誤導為危險、闖紅燈或穿紅衣服，皆不符合該片語的意思。

questions.stem: That painting must have cost you a fortune.

options.A: That painting must be a genuine one.
options.B: That painting can sell for millions of dollars.
options.C: That painting must have cost you a lot of money.
options.D: That painting has turned out to be a fake.

questions.explain:
cost a fortune: 花很多錢
genuine: 真品的
fake: 贗品
解析：原句意為「那幅畫一定花掉你一大筆錢」。片語 cost a fortune 表示花了大筆金錢，與 cost a lot of money 同義，故答案選C。選項A指畫是真品、B說能賣高價、D指畫是假貨，皆過度推測畫作真偽或未來售價，偏離原句強調「買價昂貴」的題意。

questions.stem: You are to blame.
questions.explain:
be to blame: 應受責備、該負責
responsible: 負責任的
alone: 獨自的
解析：題意為「你該受責備」。片語 be to blame 指對某事負有責任，與選項B的 be responsible for 意思完全相符，故答案選B。選項A為尾音相近的聽力干擾，C與D則是字面無關的讚美陷阱。

questions.stem: I have difficulty adapting to new surroundings.

options.A: It is difficult for me to get used to new surroundings.
options.B: I have to adopt some new polices.
options.C: It is difficult for me to make new friends.
options.D: I enjoy working in pleasant surroundings.

questions.explain:
have difficulty: 做某事有困難
adapt to: 適應
get used to: 習慣於、適應
解析：題意為「我很難適應新環境」。adapt to 等同於 get used to，have difficulty 意同 it is difficult，意思完全對應，故答案選A。選項B為字形與發音陷阱，故意用相近的 adopt（採納/收養）混淆 adapt；選項C與D則偏離題意，分別偷換成結交新朋友與享受工作環境。

questions.stem: Our customers have given us a lot of feedback.

options.A: They have given us a lot of comments.
options.B: They have given us a lot of opportunities.
options.C: They have supported us for many years.
options.D: They have complained for many years.

questions.explain:
customer: 顧客
feedback: 回饋、意見
comment: 評論、意見
解析：題意為「顧客給了我們很多回饋」。feedback 指回饋意見，與 comments 同義，因此答案選A。干擾選項 B 的 opportunities（機會）、C 的 supported（支持）與 D 的 complained（抱怨）皆屬於過度推論的語意陷阱，偏離原句核心意思。

questions.stem: We don't have any other options.

options.A: We don't have any other opinions.
options.B: We don't have any other choices.
options.C: We don't have any other solutions.
options.D: We don't have any other plans.

questions.explain:
option: 選擇
choice: 選擇
opinion: 意見
解析：題意為「我們沒有其他選擇了」。option 與 choice 為同義詞，表示選擇，故答案選B。選項A的 opinion（意見）是外型與發音相近的干擾字；選項C（解決方案）與D（計畫）則偏離原文字義。

questions.stem: Using this weapon is a piece of cake.

options.A: It is very easy to use this weapon.
options.B: It is dangerous to use this weapon.
options.C: It is a complicated weapon system.
options.D: It is a weapon used by everyone.

questions.explain:
a piece of cake: 輕而易舉的事
weapon: 武器
complicated: 複雜的
解析：題意為「使用這項武器輕而易舉」。片語 a piece of cake 指「極為容易」，與 A 選項的 very easy 意思完全相同，故答案選A。干擾選項 B（危險的）與 C（複雜的）意思均與題意相反；D（每個人都使用的武器）則是缺乏依據的過度推論，皆不可選。

questions.stem: You should keep that guy at a distance.

options.C: You should get to know him better.
options.D: You should not become too friendly with him.

questions.explain:
keep at a distance: 保持距離、疏遠
cooperate: 合作
get to know: 認識、了解
解析：題目意為「你應該和那個人保持距離」。片語 keep someone at a distance 指對人有所防備、避免過於親近，故答案選D。選項B合作與C深入了解皆為意思相反的干擾項，A尊重亦與防備疏離的題意不符。

questions.stem: Mike has become a celebrity.

options.D: He has become a famous person.

questions.explain:
celebrity: 名人
famous person: 有名的人
解析：題意為「麥克成了一位名人」。celebrity 指知名人士，與 D 選項 famous person 同義，故答案選D。選項 A 的 leader 是領導者、B 的 joke 是笑話、C 的 hero 是英雄，皆為不同意思的字義干擾，不符題意。

questions.stem: My father is a man of integrity.

options.A: My father is a man of many talents.
options.B: My father is a man of action.
options.C: My father is a man of honesty.
options.D: My father is a man of vision.

questions.explain:
integrity: 正直、誠實
a man of action: 行動派的人
a man of vision: 有遠見的人
解析：題意為「我父親是一位正直的人」。integrity 指為人正直、誠實，與 C 選項的 honesty 意思相同，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 的 talents（才華）、B 的 action（行動力）、D 的 vision（遠見）皆為換字陷阱，與原意不符。

questions.stem: Charge her meal to my account.

options.A: I'll cook a meal for her.
options.B: I'll bring a meal to her.
options.C: I'll have a meal with her.

questions.explain:
charge to one's account: 記在某人的帳上
pay for: 替...付錢
解析：題意為「把她的餐點記在我的帳上」，意思就是「我要替她付這餐的費用」，因此答案選D。選項A（煮飯給她吃）、B（帶餐點給她）與C（和她一起用餐）都是利用 meal 設下的字面干擾陷阱，完全偏離了記帳買單的意思。

questions.stem: The accident caused heavy casualties.

options.A: The accident caused a serious traffic jam.
options.B: Many people were injured or died in the accident.
options.C: The accident was caused by heavy rain.
options.D: Many people escaped from the accident.

questions.explain:
casualty: 傷亡人員、死傷
heavy casualties: 嚴重死傷
解析：題目意為這場事故造成嚴重傷亡。casualty 為軍事常用單字，指因事故或作戰傷亡的人員，與B選項意思完全相同，故答案選B。干擾選項C是借 heavy rain（豪雨）來混淆 heavy 的字面意思，A選項的塞車與D選項的人員逃脫皆不符合 casualties 的定義。

questions.stem: Jack is in no rush to leave.

options.B: He may stay a little longer.
options.C: He is under a lot of pressure.
options.D: He should be here anytime soon.

questions.explain:
in no rush: 不急、不趕時間
hurry: 匆忙、趕快
解析：題意指「傑克不急著離開」，代表他還可以再多待一會兒，因此答案選B。干擾選項A與題意完全相反；選項C的心理壓力及選項D的抵達時間，皆屬於過度推論的無關陷阱。

questions.stem: A lot of people took to the streets.
questions.explain:
take to the streets: 走上街頭（示威抗議）
protest against: 抗議、反對
解析：題幹片語 take to the streets 意指群眾「走上街頭遊行抗議」，故答案選A。選項B的流浪漢與選項C的清掃街道，皆為字面 streets 的干擾陷阱，並非該片語的真正含意。

questions.stem: Amy was taken aback by his strong reaction.

options.A: Amy was unaware of his strong reaction.
options.B: Amy was taken back to her own residence.
options.C: Amy was surprised at his strong reaction.
options.D: Amy was held in his strong arms.

questions.explain:
be taken aback: 感到吃驚
strong reaction: 強烈反應
解析：題意為艾咪對他的強烈反應感到吃驚。片語 be taken aback 表示驚訝，同義於 be surprised at，故答案選C。選項B利用字形與發音相近的 taken back（帶回）設下聽力陷阱；A（不知情）與D（被抱住）皆偏離原意。

questions.stem: Eighty percent of the citizens are satisfied with the mayor's job performance.

options.A: A lot of citizens are jobless.
options.B: Most citizens are satisfied with their jobs.
options.C: A lot of citizens will vote for someone else.
options.D: Most citizens think the mayor is doing a good job.

questions.explain:
be satisfied with: 對...感到滿意
job performance: 工作表現
citizen: 市民、公民
解析：題意指八成市民滿意市長的施政表現。80%等於most，故答案選D。選項A藉由job延伸出無關的jobless（失業）；選項B偷換概念成市民滿意「自己的」工作；選項C說要投給其他人則與文意相反。

questions.stem: This kind of bird is a rare species now.

options.C: It is very easy to breed.

questions.explain:
rare: 稀有的、罕見的
species: 物種
precious: 珍貴的
解析：題意為「這種鳥現在是稀有物種」。rare 指數量少而少見，代表非常珍貴，故答案選D。干擾選項A表示到處都有，意思完全相反；選項B說任何地方都找不到，意指已經絕種，屬於過度推論的陷阱；選項C提到容易繁殖也與稀有性不符。

questions.stem: M: How much gas do you want? W: Fill'er up. Q: Where is the man?

turns.t: How much gas do you want?
Fill'er up.
Where is the man?

questions.explain:
gas: 汽油
fill'er up: 加滿油
filling station: 加油站
解析：男士詢問要加多少汽油，女士回答請加滿。filling station為加油站，等同於gas station，因此答案選A。選項C的bus station（公車站）是以相同的station字眼作為聽覺陷阱，B藥局與D書店則與加油情境完全無關。

questions.stem: M: Have you got some change? W: What for? M: I need to make a call. Q: What is the man going to do?

turns.t: Have you got some change?
What for?
I need to make a call.
What is the man going to do?

questions.explain:
change: 零錢
make a call: 打電話
pay phone: 公共電話
解析：男子借零錢是為了打電話，由此可知他要使用投幣式公共電話，答案選C。干擾選項A的手機不需要零錢；B自動販賣機雖需零錢但不是用來通話；D影印機則與打電話完全無關。

questions.stem: W: Don't forget to add some garlic. M: But I really don't like it. W: It's essential to the flavor of the dish. Q: What is the man doing?

turns.t: Don't forget to add some garlic.
But I really don't like it.
It's essential to the flavor of the dish.
What is the man doing?

questions.explain:
garlic: 大蒜
essential: 必要的
dish: 菜餚
解析：女士提醒要加「大蒜（garlic）」以維持「菜餚（dish）的風味」，可知男子正在做菜，答案選D。選項A（洗碗）是利用 dish（菜餚／盤子）的多義性所設的字面陷阱；B（煮咖啡）與C（洗衣服）則與添加食材無關。

questions.stem: W: Why did your car get towed away? M: I double-parked. Q: Why was the man's car towed away?

turns.t: Why did your car get towed away?
I double-parked.
Why was the man's car towed away?

questions.explain:
tow away: 拖吊
double-park: 並排停車
解析：女士詢問男士的車為何被拖走，男士回答並排停車，這屬於違規停車行為，故答案選B。選項A利用twice混淆double的字面意思，並非停了兩次；選項C造成車禍與選項D想賣車皆與對話內容無關。

questions.stem: M: What do you do for a living? W: Well, I work independently for different companies. Q: What is the woman's job?

turns.t: What do you do for a living?
Well, I work independently for different companies.
What is the woman's job?

questions.explain:
for a living: 謀生
freelancer: 自由職業者
independently: 獨立地
解析：男方詢問女方以何謀生，女方回答替不同公司獨立工作，表示她是按件接案的自由工作者，故答案選A。干擾項B志工、C秘書與D街頭藝人，皆屬於特定單一職務或無給職，與為不同公司獨立接案的題意不符。

questions.stem: M: I don't think I'll get that job. W: Come on, Nick. Never say die. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.A: The man is still young enough.
options.B: Getting a job is no big deal.
options.D: Finding a job is not easy.

turns.t: I don't think I'll get that job.
Come on, Nick. Never say die.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
Never say die: 永不放棄、別氣餒
optimistic: 樂觀的
解析：男士認為自己應徵不上，女士以 Never say die 鼓勵他「永不言敗、別灰心」，也就是要他保持積極樂觀，故答案選C。A選項由 die 延伸聯想到年紀，屬於字面干擾陷阱；B與D選項皆偏離女士正面打氣的原意。

questions.stem: W: Guess what? Tom just asked me for a loan. M: It's not like him to do so. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: He is different from Tom in character.
options.C: Tom is not the woman's type.
options.D: Borrowing money is not Tom's style.

turns.t: Guess what? Tom just asked me for a loan.
It's not like him to do so.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
ask for a loan: 借錢
It's not like him: 這不像他的作風
解析：男士說「這不像他的作風」，指借錢不符合Tom平時的習慣與個性，故答案選D。選項B將介系詞 like（像）混淆為動詞「喜歡」；選項A與C則是針對「個性」與「類型」做字面干擾與過度推論，均非男士本意。

questions.stem: M: My dog ate my homework, so I have nothing to turn in. W: I wasn't born yesterday. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.D: She thinks the man gave a good reason.

turns.t: My dog ate my homework, so I have nothing to turn in.
I wasn't born yesterday.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
turn in: 繳交
born yesterday: 幼稚好騙的
解析：男士藉口作業被狗吃了沒得交，女士回覆「我又不是昨天出生的」，比喻自己「不是三歲小孩、沒那麼好騙」，因此答案選A。選項B取字面上的yesterday製造干擾；選項D則與女士不相信的態度完全相反。

questions.stem: M: Wow, you've got so many CDs! Could you lend me one? W: Take your pick. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.A: There is no need to hurry.
options.B: The man can make his choice.
options.C: She won't lend any CDs to the man.
options.D: The man must pay some rent to her.

turns.t: Wow, you've got so many CDs! Could you lend me one?
Take your pick.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
lend: 借出
take your pick: 任你挑選、自己選
解析：男士詢問能否借一片CD，女士回答Take your pick表示「你自己挑選」，故答案選B。選項C與女士願意借的語意完全相反；選項D則是混淆lend（借出）與rent（租金），均為錯誤干擾。

questions.stem: W: Would you like a stick of chewing gum? M: No, thanks. I've got some cavities. Q: Why doesn't the man want chewing gum?

options.B: He is busy with some activities.

turns.t: Would you like a stick of chewing gum?
No, thanks. I've got some cavities.
Why doesn't the man want chewing gum?

questions.explain:
cavity: 蛀牙
chewing gum: 口香糖
kick the habit: 戒除習慣
解析：男士因有 cavities（蛀牙）而拒絕口香糖，蛀牙即 bad teeth，故答案選A。選項B利用 activities 與 cavities 的相近發音製造聽力陷阱；C、D選項則與對話內容完全無關。

questions.stem: Before you take any medicine, you should read the _______ on the label and follow them closely.
questions.explain: directions: 指示; actions: 行動; conditions: 狀況; fashions: 時尚

questions.stem: They live in an old house, _______ roof may collapse anytime.
questions.explain:
whose:（用作關係代名詞）它的；它們的: 他們住在一個屋頂隨時會倒塌的房
子裡

questions.stem: Bacteria are not all bad. In fact, quite a few species of them are _______ to our health.
questions.explain:
beneficial: 有益的, 有幫助的; factual: 事實的; mutual: 相互的, 共同的; social:
社會的

questions.stem: Among our guests _______ a famous host of a popular talk show, Mr. Crane.
questions.explain: 此句為倒裝句, S (主詞): a famous host…, 故選is.

questions.stem: Money _______ cannot save their marriage. They have a few other problems to worry about, too.
questions.explain:
N+alone…, alone: 僅,單單; only+N…, only: 唯一的，僅有的; mere+N…,
mere: 僅僅的

questions.stem: In my opinion, the two soccer teams are _______ matched.
questions.explain: evenly: 均勻地, 修飾V.

questions.stem: The week-long rainfall may _______ landslides in the mountain area.
questions.explain:
bring about : cause引起, 造成; set down: 放下;寫下; make up: 補足 ; run
across: 偶然遇見

questions.stem: The man was convicted of murder and was _______ to 20 years in prison
questions.explain:
sentence sb. (to sth.): 判決，宣判某人… ; order: 命令; requeset: 要求;
persuade: 說服

questions.stem: I'm _______ a petty clerk here. I have no authority to make such a decision.
questions.explain:
anything but... = far from... = not at all... = by no means (不…); nothing but=
nothing more than僅僅

questions.stem: Peter stayed in Kyoto for three years _______ more about Japanese history and culture.
questions.explain:
do something to+Vr... = do something (in order) to+Vr...待在Kyoto三年, 為
了...

questions.stem: Drinking a lot of water can help _______ the risk of developing kidney stones.
questions.explain: decrease: 降低; affect: 影響; collect: 收集; preserve: 保存

questions.stem: Because computers are getting less expensive, they are _______ used in schools and offices today.
questions.explain: widely: 廣泛地; hardly: 幾乎不…; clearly: 清楚地; evenly: 平均地

questions.stem: _______ June 15, all staff members must wear their badges at work.
questions.explain: As of/ as from: 從...起; As for: 至於, 說到; as if/as though: 似乎,彷彿

questions.stem: Personal hygiene cannot be _______, especially in summer.
questions.explain:
overestimate: 對……評價過高; overcharge: 對……索價過高; overcrowded:
過於擁擠的; overexcited: 過於興奮的

questions.stem: In addition to _______ his hair blue, Jason has tattoos from the waist up.
questions.explain: in addition to + Ving, 再根據題意,選dying. Dye (v) : 染色

questions.stem: I have never dreamed of there _______ such a place as Shangri La in the world.
questions.explain: dream of +Ving, 所以選being.

questions.stem: The meeting got _______, and the chairman had to call a halt to it.
questions.explain:
on hand = at hand = around the corner即將到來; in hand = under control: 掌
控中; out of hand = out of control: 失控

questions.stem: No sooner had I left the restaurant _______ I felt like throwing up.
questions.explain:
No sooner+had+S+Vpp (過去分詞)…than+S+Ved (過去式): 一…馬上…;
throw up: vomit 嘔吐

questions.stem: If you need any advice on legal matters, please feel _______ to call me.
questions.explain: feel free to…: 隨意…

questions.stem: Everything in the world changes over time, and human languages are no _______.
questions.explain:
exception: 例外的人或事物; reception: 接待會,歡迎會; deception: 欺騙;
conception: 設想；構想

questions.stem: To play fair, everyone must _______ the rules.
questions.explain:
abide by: follow (遵守); account for: explain (說明); apply for…: 申請; appeal
to:訴諸，求助於，吸引

questions.stem: One of the problems we are faced with is _______ we are running of gasoline.
questions.explain: that 引導 n. clause (名詞子句), 作為主詞捕語.

questions.stem: To do him _______, Captain Hook really has a heart of gold although he is irritable.
questions.explain:
do justice to sb/sth: 公平地對待; 公平地評判; peace: 和平; ease: 容易; lease:
租約

questions.stem: I didn't know who had called, but the voice was definitely _______ of an elderly woman.
questions.explain: that: pronoun (代名詞), 代替前面 ‘voice’.

questions.stem: You hair is too long. It's about time you _______ it cut.
questions.explain:
It is time + S+ Ved (past tense) = It implies that it's a little late更暗示現在才
做某事已經有點晚了, 也 可以說 It is high time …（現在是非常適當的時候）

questions.stem: You'd better _______ an umbrella with you. It looks like it may rain any minute.
questions.explain: had better + Vr (動詞原型)

questions.stem: My wife has trouble falling asleep, so she has to take sleeping _______ before going to bed.
questions.explain: pills: 藥丸; bills: 帳單; drills: 鑽頭, 鑽機, 訓練; mills: 磨坊, 麵粉廠

questions.stem: I have to _______ to and from work five days a week.
questions.explain: commute: 通勤；connect: 連結；compare: 比較 ; concern: 關心

questions.stem: Of all the office workers surveyed last week, only 5 percent said they _______ the Net.
questions.explain:
考tense (時態), 根據Of…workers surveyed last week, 所以選past participle
(過去完成式)

questions.stem: My older sister _______ have fights with me, but we are very close now
questions.explain: used to be ...: ... ever ... before, ...not anymore now. (曾經…現在不再…)

questions.stem: If I _______ start my life all over again, I might marry someone like you.
questions.explain:
If S+Ved, S+might (could, would)+Vr: conditional clause (與現在事實相反之
假設語態)

questions.stem: I suggested that Cindy _______ on that pink dress in the fitting room.
questions.explain: suggest+that S+should+Vr…, 其中should可省略.

questions.stem: _______ their age difference, they fell in love and eventually got married.
questions.explain: despite + n (名詞) = in spite of + n; although (though) + clause (子句)

questions.stem: _______ 50 people have signed up for voluntary work in that hospital.
questions.explain:
approximately: 大概的,近似的; apparently: 明顯地; patiently:有耐心地;
practically: 實際地

questions.stem: There is a _______ that if you break a mirror, you'll have bad luck for seven years.
questions.explain: superstition: 迷信; supplement: 增補，補充 ; suppression: 鎮壓，平定

questions.stem: Some people eat mostly fast food. One study shows that most fast-food eaters have a lot in common. They are competitive and good at business. They are also usually in a hurry. Many fast-food eaters might not agree with this description of their personalities, but it is a common picture of them. Which of the following is a trait of fast-food eaters?

options.B: They are often on the go.
options.C: They tend to disagree with each other.

questions.explain:
in a hurry: 匆忙、趕時間
on the go: 忙碌奔波
trait: 特徵、特質
解析：題目詢問常吃速食者的特徵。文中提到他們「usually in a hurry」，與「often on the go」語意相符，故答案選B。選項A保守並未提及；選項C誤將「不同意該人格描述」扭曲為「彼此常意見不合」；選項D則是將 common picture（普遍形象）扭曲為拍照片（taking pictures）的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: During the second half of 2010, the price of corn rose sharply－73 percent in the United States. Most researchers attributed the soaring price to the greater use of American corn for making biofuel. Why did the price of corn rise so sharply in the United States?

options.C: Because demand for corn as food was increasing.
options.D: Because more and more corn was used to make fuel.

questions.explain:
soar: 暴漲
attribute to: 歸因於
biofuel: 生質燃料
解析：題目詢問玉米價格暴漲的原因。文中指出研究人員將價格飆漲歸因於玉米被大量用於製造生質燃料，因此答案選D。選項A欠收、B天災及C糧食需求增加，在文中均未提及，屬於憑生活經驗臆測的常識干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Automatic faucets use an electronic sensor to start and stop the flow of water when people wash their hands. These faucets save a lot of water. But, recently, scientists have found out these faucets contain far more bacteria than manual faucets. What is the main point of the passage?

options.A: Automatic faucets are convenient to use.
options.B: Automatic faucets save a lot of water.
options.C: Automatic faucets may not be safe to use.
options.D: Automatic faucets are very popular now.

questions.explain:
automatic faucet: 自動水龍頭
electronic sensor: 電子感應器
bacteria: 細菌
解析：文章雖提及自動水龍頭能省水，但隨後用 But 帶出核心重點：其含菌量遠高於手動水龍頭，具有衛生安全疑慮，因此答案選C。選項B僅為前半段的次要細節，非全文主旨；選項A與D則是常見的常識干擾選項，文中並未提及。

questions.stem: Dentists think that women can put up with more pain than men. Michael is a dentist and he says, "Women are more aware of what pain is than a man." Men do not seem to expect any pain and are surprised when the drilling hurts. Pain researchers think that men aren't prepared for pain. What can be implied from the passage?

options.A: Women can endure pain better than men.
options.B: Most dentists around the world are male.
options.C: Men are always ready to endure pain.
options.D: Female dentists are more welcome than male ones.

questions.explain:
put up with: 忍受
endure: 忍受、忍耐
be aware of: 察覺、明白
解析：文章首句指出女性比男性更能忍受疼痛，與A選項意思相符，其中endure即為put up with的同義字，故答案選A。干擾項B與D提及牙醫性別比例及受歡迎程度，文中完全未提及，屬無中生有的陷阱；C選項稱男性隨時準備好忍痛，則與文中「男性沒做好心理準備」的文意完全相反。

questions.stem: French President Nicolas Sarkozy is calling for new international nuclear safety standards, warning radiation leaks at Japan's Fukushima power plant could have effects on a global level. What is the French president's warning about?

options.A: The radiation leaks could harm Japan's economy.
options.B: The radiation leaks could affect the entire world.
options.C: The radiation leaks could be dealt with easily.
options.D: The radiation leaks could worsen global warming.

questions.explain:
radiation leak: 輻射外洩
on a global level: 在全球層面
nuclear safety standard: 核安標準
解析：題幹指出法國總統警告福島輻射外洩可能在「全球層面」造成影響，也就是會波及全世界，故答案選B。選項A的日本經濟與C的容易處理均與題意不符；選項D則是藉由題目中的global一詞，刻意延伸出「全球暖化」的字面干擾陷阱。
